spiritgiven.comments: Lots of high fives, compliments, encouraging comments, great spirit captains communication

Confusions about rules regarding max stalls, wrong positions after stoppage, resolution of gender ratio violations
A few rough physical contacts (elbows) during throws and skying competitions, body contacts off discs
Communication off the fields was fantastic especially with spirit captains, but not so much on the field

Avoiding contacts with floaty discs and very aware of other players
Respectfully and cautiously bringing in the perspectives on the sideline before offering their opinion
High fives and great vibes in windy conditions

Great rule knowledge of incorrect calls 
Body It would be better to be more mindful more body awareness especially when theres floaty discs
Asked involved players to speak first and ready to listen, great following up with calls, gender violations, etc
Positivity and calmness throughout the game, even though it was a tight game
Very aware of female players and avoided contact, quick resolutions on calls

spiritreceived.comments: Thanks for the a well spirited game :)

The lack of rules knowledge affected calls not being resolved correctly nor in a timely manner.
There was a lot of unnecessary contact and dangerous plays. A lot of the contact continued after we spoke about it
Great attitude and intensity, regardless of wind and score. Great layouts, fair fights for every disc, rhank you!
great communication between both teams and we really appreciate the friendliness and cheerfulness on and off the field.

Thank you for the game!

We think the rules knowledge and use is not quite there yet with movement during calls and being unclear about travel being a stoppage of play or not.

We thought the calls were fair and you gave us the benefit of the doubt; thank you!

We thought your attitude was great towards us during the calls and conducting yourselves during the game.

All the best to your team!
